verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Abacum serves an llms.txt at https://www.abacum.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Its content appears to be a product and capability summary (integrations, consolidation, demo) rather than deep technical or agent-workflow docs, and the per-page markdown probe returned 404. missing for 10: per-page markdown or llms-full style agent docs, developer/API-oriented content in llms.txt, independent corroboration of agent usability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
